name: Back-UPS BX950MI
description: Power profile for the APC Back-UPS BX950MI (950 VA / 520 W). Estimates real-time input power (drawn from the wall) from the NUT load percentage, nominal real power plus the UPS self-consumption.
measure_description: Self-consumption measured as the difference between two Shelly Plug S Gen3 meters placed one before and one after the UPS; the median delta over 10 samples was ~15 W.
config_flow_discovery_remarks: This calculation uses the 'Nominal real power' diagnostic in the NUT integration. You need to enable that first.
